model_limitations: Backend snapshot/version and stochastic seed cannot be pinned; verify actual child model and effort in each native log.
session_isolation: fork_turns=none; no task history; each worker may read only own input folder and write own output folder; no web, other runs or evaluation files

budget.enforcement: worker instruction and post-run audit; host may not enforce a hard per-child token ceiling

human_policy: No clarification, continuation or editing of raw answers; root may fix packaging separately without changing raw files.
evaluation_policy: Use frozen rubric on every result; group-visible developer evaluation is disclosed, not independent or blind expert review.
record_policy: Retain authentic native logs privately; publish chronological visible export with original hash, excluding system/developer content and hidden reasoning. No invented tool events.
user_authorization: User explicitly authorized independent experimental subagents in this chat on 2026-10-28; no separate API key required.
